result.summary: This PR removes several assertions checking WALLET_FLAG_DESCRIPTORS across CWallet methods, on the premise that many of these methods are inherently descriptor-specific or that the assertions are outdated since legacy wallets can no longer be loaded. A second commit moves an UpgradeDescriptorCache flag check out to its callers. The stated motivation is purely to reduce cognitive load reading wallet.cpp.
result.problem: The author finds redundant WALLET_FLAG_DESCRIPTORS assertions annoying to read through in CWallet; there is no reported bug or user complaint driving this.

result.card: This draft PR removes several WALLET_FLAG_DESCRIPTORS assertions from CWallet purely to reduce reading friction in wallet.cpp, with no bug or user request behind it. Reviewer b-l-u-e reproduced that removing the EncryptWallet assertion converts a clean assertion failure into a SIGABRT deep inside DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan::SetupDescriptorGeneration, suggesting the assertion is actually load-bearing rather than redundant; frankomosh raised the same concern earlier and got no reply. The author has been silent since 2026-02-04 (224 days), the PR needs rebase, and it is still marked draft after the author's own report of a functional-test failure. Given the unresolved evidence of a real correctness risk and no clear user-facing benefit, this is low priority for wallet reviewers and currently blocked on author response.
